ev.q: VE against laboratory-confirmed COVID-19–associated ED/UC encounters was 24% after 1 Janssen dose
Overall, VE against laboratory-confirmed COVID-19–associated ED/UC encounters was significantly higher among patients who had received any booster dose
Models were adjusted using inverse propensity to be vaccinated weights (calculated separately for each VE estimate)

methods_quotes.q: investigators estimated VE by comparing the odds of a positive SARS-CoV-2 test result between vaccinated and unvaccinated patients
Models were adjusted using inverse propensity to be vaccinated weights (calculated separately for each VE estimate)
A statistically significant difference was indicated by nonoverlapping 95% CIs or standardized mean or proportion differences ≥0.2
Odds ratios were estimated using multivariable logistic regression.
VE was calculated as [1 − odds ratio] x 100%.
Generalized boosted regression trees were used to estimate the propensity to be vaccinated
